FEAT-2-S114.title: Define Specialty Identification Input/Output Schema
FEAT-2-S114.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for specialty identification requests and responses, including normalized user query input and structured NUCC code output with confidence scores.

FEAT-2-S115.title: Integrate Specialty Service with FindCare Facade
FEAT-2-S115.description: Integrate specialty identification into the find_care_facade to ensure user queries are enriched with NUCC specialty codes prior to provider search execution.

FEAT-2-S116.title: Implement NUCC Code Normalization and Deduplication Layer
FEAT-2-S116.description: Add a normalization layer within specialty_service to standardize NUCC codes, remove duplicates, and aggregate related classifications before returning results.

FEAT-2-S117.title: Add Query Expansion Support for Specialty Detection
FEAT-2-S117.description: Leverage embedding_client query expansion capabilities to enhance specialty detection coverage for ambiguous or layperson queries before mapping to NUCC codes.
